scenario: Status flip on cortical sulci + sinus normal denying mucosal thickening + merged pred umbrellas (1:N)
description: Real subset of brain-mr/findings_{gt,pred}/example_1 (negative scan in gt, pred adds two abnormalities and merges some completeness statements). Demonstrates a status flip on hemispheric cortical sulci (gt 'compatible with age' = normal vs pred 'mildly prominent for age' = abnormal — INC downstream), an organ-level normal statement denying an abnormality (gt 'Paranasal sinuses are normal' vs pred left maxillary sinus mucosal thickening — a status inversion, matched), and merged pred completeness statements acting as 1:N umbrellas (medulla/pons/mesencephalon + cerebellum; orbits + paranasal sinuses), each bound to every gt statement it covers.

pred_findings.text: Medulla oblongata, pons, mesencephalon, both cerebellar hemispheres, and vermis parenchyma are normal.
Hemispheric cortical sulcal widths are mildly prominent for the patient's age.
Bilateral orbits and paranasal sinuses are normal.
Mucosal thickening in the left maxillary sinus.
